arxiv-2011-11901.title: Ground state properties and exact thermodynamics of a 2-leg anisotropic spin ladder system
arxiv-2011-11901.creator: Sk Saniur Rahaman 1, Shaon Sahoo 2, Manoranjan Kumar 1
arxiv-2011-11901.description: Abstract We study a frustrated two-leg spin ladder with alternate isotropic Heisenberg and Ising rung exchange interactions, whereas, interactions along legs and diagonals are Ising-type. All the interactions in the ladder are anti-ferromagnetic in nature and induce frustration in the system.

arxiv-2108-01280.title: A Study of Multilingual End-to-End Speech Recognition for Kazakh, Russian, and English
arxiv-2108-01280.creator: Saida Mussakhojayeva, Yerbolat Khassanov, Huseyin Atakan Varol
arxiv-2108-01280.description: Abstract We study training a single end-to-end (E2E) automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for three languages used in Kazakhstan: Kazakh, Russian, and English. We first describe the development of multilingual E2E ASR based on Transformer networks and then perform an extensive assessment on the aforementioned languages. We also compare two variants of output grapheme set construction: combined and independent.

arxiv-2109-04822.title: 1st-Order Dynamics on Nonlinear Agents for Resource Allocation over Uniformly-Connected Networks
arxiv-2109-04822.creator: Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian, Alireza Aghasi, Maria Vrakopoulou, Themistoklis Charalambous
arxiv-2109-04822.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian, Alireza Aghasi, Maria Vrakopoulou, Themistoklis Charalambous. A general nonlinear 1 1 st-order consensus-based solution for distributed constrained convex optimization is proposed with network resource allocation applications. The solution is used to optimize continuously-differentiable strictly convex cost functions over weakly-connected undirected networks, while it is anytime feasible and models various nonlinearities to account for imperfections and constraints on the (physical model of) agents in terms of limited actuation capabilities, e.g., quantization and saturation.

arxiv-2210-04913.title: Populations of Magnetized Filaments in the Intracluster Medium and the Galactic Center
arxiv-2210-04913.creator: F. Yusef-Zadeh, R. G. Arendt, M. Wardle
arxiv-2210-04913.description: Abstract Magnetized radio filaments are found in abundance in the inner few hundred pc of our Galaxy. Progress in understanding this population of filaments has been slow over the last few decades, in part due to a lack of detection elsewhere in the Galaxy or in external galaxies.

arxiv-2303-18221.title: Fluctuation without dissipation: Microcanonical Langevin Monte Carlo
arxiv-2303-18221.creator: Jakob Robnik, Uroš Seljak
arxiv-2303-18221.description: Abstract Stochastic sampling algorithms such as Langevin Monte Carlo are inspired by physical systems in a heat bath. Their equilibrium distribution is the canonical ensemble given by a prescribed target distribution, so they must balance fluctuation and dissipation as dictated by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem.

pmc-12398129.title: Reduced perioperative sensory impairment could lower postoperative delirium incidence: a before-and-after study in older patients with hip fracture
pmc-12398129.creator: Jan Wilhelm Busse, Alexander Ranker, Manfred Gogol, Christian Macke, Emmanouil Liodakis, Derya Strack, Lukas Hinken, Carolin Jung
pmc-12398129.description: BackgroundPostoperative delirium (POD) is a common complication in older patients. Multicomponent prevention reduces POD but requires substantial resources. The effect of single interventions derived from multicomponent programs remains elusive, but it is essential to assess their effect to identify which components are meaningful. This study investigates whether a single intervention from a multicomponent program may reduce the incidence of POD.

pmc-13273876.creator: Peter Wilmshurst
pmc-13273876.description: One-quarter of adults have a persistent (patent) foramen ovale (PFO). Right-to-left shunting through a PFO can facilitate paradoxical thromboembolism, cryptogenic stroke, paradoxical gas embolism, decompression sickness, arterial hypoxaemia and migraine with aura. Atrial septal defects and pulmonary shunts are also associated with these diseases, and investigation must differentiate them from a PFO.

pmc-13520958.title: Thirst in End-Stage Liver Disease: From Symptom Disregard to a Multidisciplinary Clinical Pathway and Future Perspectives: A Narrative Review
pmc-13520958.creator: Min Xu, Shuhui Yang, Siyan Guo, Junwei Su, Xiaoxin Wu
pmc-13520958.description: PurposeThirst is a common but clinically under-recognized symptom among patients with end-stage liver disease (ESLD) and may adversely affect comfort, nutritional intake, treatment adherence, and quality of life. This review aimed to systematically elucidate the pathogenesis, clinical management dilemmas, and limitations of current interventions, while highlighting the need for population-specific assessment tools and an integrated management framework.
